en: Sepia-toned image showing a neoclassical complex with a grand central building featuring a columned portico and sweeping curved staircases, flanked by long rectangular wings with rows of columns or tall windows. The architecture is monumental and formal, occupying a large open square or plaza in the foreground. At the bottom right faint text reads "Library - Athens," and at the lower left a circular seal or logo is visible. A web address "www.elia.org.gr" is printed across the lower part of the image.
